routes.name: zero-weighted-count: rank-free affine pair estimate and full Lean specialization
zero-weighted-count: infer a logarithmic zero-count from a log-squared fixed fiber

C9000191.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 191 (A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound.; papers: A power improvement in the Heilbronn triangle lower bound; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/191.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ZERO_WEIGHTED.statement: Proposition zero:weighted-zero, uniformly in every admissible fixed C: sum W(A) <= K log(2N) N^6/I^2.

C_ZERO_LATTICE.statement: A unit-pivot matrix over Z/B^k has row-lattice index DE and E Z^3 containment, including all singular pivots.

C_ZERO_PLANE.statement: For primitive x, J_x=I|x|/g(x), g(x)|E, reduction onto x-perp mod q, and spanning row triples in an index-m plane sublattice count at most 576^3 N^6/(m J_x)^3.

C_ZERO_MOMENT.statement: For every R>=h, sum of g(x)^3 over primitive R<=|x|<2R is at most 250 R^3 I.

C_ZERO_AUX.statement: The normalized inclusion weight, including repeats, has the exact support, short-null exclusion and bounds W<=4, W<=2U, W<=2U^2 with U<=2000^3 q h^12.

C_ZERO_NULL.statement: A determinant-zero box matrix with pairwise distinct projections has a primitive right null vector with every coordinate nonzero and norm<=16N^2.

C_ZERO_CASES.statement: The affine, extra-equation equal-pair, exceptional rank>=2, and exceptional rank<=1 shell sums satisfy the four explicit bounds and sum to the required logarithmic bound.

C_ZERO_THREE_CASES.statement: Two distinct auxiliary residues have W<=4U even at linear rank one. All-equal triples admit a nonexceptional equal pair. The resulting three-case proof establishes the full logarithmic zero-count without an assumed count.

C_MAIN.statement: Manuscript Theorem intro:main: every sufficiently large n has a configuration with minimum triangle area >= c n^(-2+eta), eta=2/(45435k+16). Outside this bounded mission's certification scope.

C_NORM.statement: norm:decomposition and norm:obstruction: distinct labels force the determinant residue outside [-tau,tau]. Not audited in full by this mission.

C_ORBIT.statement: orb:orbit: the special-linear orbit has size at least (21/64) h^8/(D^3 E^2). Not certified by this mission.

C_CONDITIONAL.statement: orb:conditional: E[D|labels]<=2 for every fixed label triple at the construction parameters. Not certified by this mission.

C_LIFT.statement: sam:lifting: the exact conditional probability is h^9/(N^9 |O|) times the orbit-restricted weighted sum, including repeated auxiliary residues. Not independently certified by this mission.

C_NONZERO.statement: lat:fixed-det and sam:weighted-count for nonzero determinant give a uniform log-squared fixed-fiber bound. Not a proof of C_ZERO_WEIGHTED.

C_ALTERATION.statement: alt:expected-events through alt:exponent and cardinality interpolation yield the final all-sufficiently-large-n conclusion. Not independently certified by this mission.
